parts.text: The IGCSE class is investigating the resistance of a wire. Fig. 3.1 shows the circuit used. Fig. 3.1

parts.text: (a) A student measures the current I in the circuit and the p.d. V across a length l = 0.250 m of the wire PQ . He repeats the readings using a range of different lengths of the wire. The readings are shown in Table 3.1. Table 3.1 l / V / I / R / 0.250 0.50 0.33 0.350 0.69 0.36 0.450 0.90 0.32 0.550 1.11 0.34 0.650 1.32 0.35 0.750 1.50 0.33

parts.text: (i) Calculate the resistance R of each length l of wire using the equation R = V I . Record the values of R in the table.
